summary: A Bitcoin layer 2 settles to a base layer it cannot change, borrows consensus from a third ecosystem, and runs a bridge whose trust root is cryptography of its own choosing. Where the post-quantum exposure actually sits, and who can fix each part.

SHRINCS demotes SLH-DSA to a fallback path and puts a 548-byte stateful signature on the primary one. What the draft reuses from FIPS 205, what it only reparameterises, what it constructs anew, and what it gives up.

NIST's final transition report keeps 2030 and 2035 but deprecates quantum-vulnerable public-key cryptography at every key size, builds in the federal 2030 and 2031 deadlines, and names ML-KEM-768 as the default. What changed from the 2024 draft, sentence by sentence.
summary_zh: NIST 的最终版过渡报告保留了 2030 年和 2035 年这两个日期，但把所有密钥长度的量子脆弱公钥密码都纳入弃用范围，写入了联邦政府 2030 年和 2031 年的截止日期，并把 ML-KEM-768 定为默认选择。逐句对照 2024 年草案，看看改了什么。
